title: Seoul police arrest 52 over fake plastic surgery reviews posted with hacked portal accounts bought from a Qingdao hacking group
date_note: SBS's article is dated 26 November and gives no separate announcement date.
summary: SBS News reports that police in Seoul arrested 52 people, including plastic surgery clinic and ad agency staff, over fake reviews posted with Korean portal accounts bought from a hacking group in Qingdao, China. Police took steps to preserve proceeds identified as criminal for confiscation.
plain: SBS says Seoul police arrested 52 people for posting fake clinic reviews with hacked portal accounts bought from a Chinese hacking group.
exec: SBS reports clinics bought hacked portal accounts to post fake reviews, a reminder that stolen accounts feed review fraud.

sources.name: SBS News: [D리포트] 성형외과 가짜 후기 8천 건 적발…중국 해킹조직에서 사들인 계정 활용

evidence.quote: 성형외과와 광고업체 직원 등 52명이 경찰에 붙잡혔습니다.

validation.note: Only SBS News was read; no police release or second publisher found.
